# LEIBHOLZ GOES FROM 24 TO 2. THIMM GOES FROM 66 TO 75.
# THIMM IS THE CONTROL AND IT IS NOT AN IDLE ONE: Johanna Thimm of Sauerbaum is Kurt's own
# great-grandmother, an East Prussian and not Jewish. Her surname is as common in the 1943
# book as in the 1933 one. SO THE SCANNER DID NOT GET WORSE, THE FRAKTUR DID NOT GET HARDER,
# AND THE BOOK DID NOT GET SMALLER. Bergmann, a large mixed name, is flat. Hirschfeld, plainly
# Jewish, declines but far less steeply, which this archive cannot explain and does not pretend to.
# WHAT THIS DOES NOT SAY, and the limits matter more than the number:
#  - A PAGE HIT IS A PAGE, NOT A PERSON. Twenty-four hits is not twenty-four Leibholzes.
#  - THE NUMBERS ARE SMALL. Twenty-four to two is a real direction across four years with a
#    flat control, but it is not a population statistic.
#  - THE MECHANISM IS NOT DISTINGUISHED. Deportation, emigration and administrative exclusion
#    from directories all look identical in a count. Jews were being pushed out of German
#    commercial listings from 1938 quite apart from being deported. THE COUNT CANNOT TELL
#    THOSE APART and this archive is not going to pretend it can.

column1: # THIS IS A LEAD AND NOT A FINDING. Nothing read here links Alfred Luwinski to Auguste. What
# is true is that a Luwinski household was in Berlin in the clothing trade in the years Lizzy
# was a dressmaker there, that Luwinski is not a common Berlin name — twenty-three pages in a
# hundred and seventy years of directories — and that Joachim Luwinski and Johanna Thimm of
# Sauerbaum will have had children besides Auguste. A BROTHER IS THE OBVIOUS GUESS AND IT IS
# A GUESS. Putbusser Straße 24 in Wedding is a specific address and can be checked against
# the Berlin registration records.
# *** 20 SEPTEMBER 2026: TEIL IV, THE STREET SECTION — A HALF OF THESE BOOKS NOBODY HERE HAD OPENED
# Every earlier pass at these volumes read TEIL I, householders by NAME. There is a TEIL IV that
# lists the same people BY STREET, house by house, with the OWNER first and the tenants under him.
# It answers a question Teil I cannot: WHO ELSE LIVED IN THE BUILDING.

Handelsgerichtsrat *** · Bayer, W., Oberstleutn. · Eberhardt, C., Kfm. · Jakob, W., Maurer · Mannowsky, S., vw. Geh. Reg. Rat · Petras, M., kfm. Angest. · Rosenstock, L., kfm. Angest. · *** SPIER, H., Handelsvertr. *** · *** — M., Vertret. *** · Sundheimer, M., Handelsvertr. · Wendorf, R., Abteilungsleit. · 6 E Alquist, R., Ingen. (Wiesbaden)".

column2: AND IT INTERLOCKS WITH THE 1939 CENSUS, NAME BY NAME
column3: the census database gives seventeen persecuted people at that address. Four of them are in this directory entry and the directory adds what the census cannot: WHICH OF THEM OWNED THE HOUSE and WHAT THEY DID. "E EISENBERG, G., vw. Handelsgerichtsrat" is EIGENTÜMERIN — GERTRUD [TRUDE] EISENBERG née HAAKE, born 09.06.1879, A COMMERCIAL COURT COUNCILLOR'S WIDOW WHO OWNED THE BUILDING. Rosenstock, L. is LEO, born 08.01.1886. Sundheimer, M. is MAX, born 19.09.1877.

column2: *** AND THE TWO SPIERS ARE NAMED AND DATED ***
column3: SPIER, H., Handelsvertr. is HANS SPIER, born 02.12.1894, a commercial agent. The dash line beneath him — the convention that cost this archive four households in a single day last week — is a SECOND SPIER, initial M., also a Vertreter: MAX SPIER, born 12.04.1864, WHO DIED ON 26 MARCH 1941. So the "b/Spier" on Jacob Leibholz's 1943 AJDC card is Hans Spier's rooms, and the elder Spier had been dead nearly two years by the time Jacob was put there.

column1: # *** AND THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF, WHICH IS THE BIGGER FIND ***

column2: THE VIEWER HAS A SOLR QUERY API AND PER-PAGE OCR
column3: digital.zlb.de runs the Goobi viewer. POST to /viewer/api/v1/index/query/ with {"query":"+PI_TOPSTRUCT:34115495_YYYY +FULLTEXT:word","count":N,"resultFields":["ORDER"]} returns THE IMAGE NUMBERS OF EVERY PAGE CONTAINING THE WORD. GET /viewer/api/v1/records/{pi}/pages/{order}/text/ returns that page's OCR as JSON. Neither was used in the earlier work, which navigated by alphabet and read images.

(1) FRAKTUR OCR MANGLES WORDS. "Treuchtlinger" returns NOTHING in Teil IV; the fuzzy form "Treuchtlinger~1" returns exactly the two right pages. ALWAYS TRY THE FUZZY FORM BEFORE CONCLUDING A STREET IS ABSENT. (2) THE TEIL IV OCR IS COLUMN-INTERLEAVED and reads as nonsense — it is good for FINDING a page and useless for READING one. The page must still be cropped and looked at. (3) The TOC's page numbers are PRINTED page numbers and are NOT the image ORDER; Teil IV printed 1629 is image 5933, an offset of about 4304 in the 1939 volume, and the offset differs per volume and per Teil.

column2: the working recipe, written down so it is not rediscovered
column3: FIND the page with a fuzzy FULLTEXT query on the street name restricted to ORDER:[5000 TO *] · CONFIRM by fetching /full/1500,/0/default.jpg and looking · READ by cropping with IIIF percentages, /pct:x,y,w,h/full/0/default.jpg, and upscaling three times. The whole Treuchtlinger lookup took six requests.

column2: what it adds about the family
column3: JACOB IS LISTED AT HIS OWN ADDRESS AS "LEIBHOLZ, J., KFM." — Kaufmann, merchant, which is the trade the transport list of February 1943 would record as "OHNE". THE BUILDING WAS NOT HIS: the owner is SALOMONSKI, M., living at Tauentzienstraße in W 50. And the SCHADE family of the 1939 census — Friedrich b.1906, Klara née Fuchs, Heinz b.1933 — is here as two householders, "Schade, F., kfm. Angest." and the dash line "— F., sen., Kfm.", father and son.

column2: *** AND IT TESTS TODAY'S READING OF DocID 11214358 IMAGE 002, WHICH SURVIVES BUT ONLY JUST ***
column3: this archive read that second sheet today as the HOUSE LIST FOR MERANER STRASSE 2, on the strength of ANNA PUFF (b. 01.06.1895) appearing both on it and in the 1939 census at that address, and of the stamp "Lt. Hausliste 1945 n. erfaßt". THE 1939 DIRECTORY WAS THEN CHECKED AGAINST THE SHEET'S OTHER SIX NAMES — Schmidt, Heinicke, Herzog, Biere, Koch and Nicksch — AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS A HOUSEHOLDER AT MERANER STRASSE 2 IN 1939.

column2: and why that is not fatal, stated as an argument and not as a fact
column3: TWO REASONS, AND BOTH ARE ORDINARY. The directory lists HOUSEHOLDERS, not every resident, so lodgers and women in another person's household never appear in it — Anna Puff herself is in the census at that address and NOT in the directory. And the stamp on the card says HAUSLISTE 1945: a list made six years and a war later, in a city where the bombed-out were rehoused constantly, should not match a 1939 householder list. THE READING STANDS AND IT IS NOW A READING WITH A TEST BEHIND IT RATHER THAN ONE MATCH.
